item.title: Speed cushions near Philadelphia schools improperly installed: City Controller
item.description: Nearly all the speed cushions near city schools were improperly installed, according to a report by the Philadelphia Controller's Office.The review comes after residents across the city voiced their concerns about the speed cushions.Officials found 95% of the speed cushions exceed the maximum grade, or slope, that is recommended by state and federal transportation guidelines. item.title: Phillies release OF Nick Castellanos, who addressed 'Miami incident' on social media
item.description: The Philadelphia Phillies have released outfielder Nick Castellanos, the team announced on Thursday.Castellanos' release comes after the Phillies reportedly told the outfielder not to show up to spring training. The 33-year-old signed a 5-year, $100M contract with the Phillies before the 2022 season.
